text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ahh... The wind feels so nice. Thank you
for
inviting me here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I think I would like to declare my goal to
the gods
in order to motivate myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
For me, a shrine is a place to show my
resolve.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My dream is not merely something I
hope for. It is
something I must fulfill.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Now, to show my resolve, I—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The twelve Umamusume gods are one!
The
eternal Golgol has descended to
Earth!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Gold Ship. Are you up to your usual antics?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! What would you ask of me,
lost one?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Grrr, you're not listening at all. In that
case, I'll
ignore you too and focus only
on my declaration.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Focus... Focus, McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Nrghhh...Grrrr!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I was able to focus! To your

disappointment, I'm sure, Gold Ship.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh! How are you doin' over there,
Coo-Maru?!
How long's it been, five
light years?

text_block_list.name: Coo-Maru
text_block_list.text: Coo! Coo-coo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Wha... Is she still not listening?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ahh, so the Crow Empire is still as
powerful as ever. The day they pull out
the sacred sword of
legend is fast
approaching.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Argh! I was doing such a good job
concentrating...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Now I'm just irritated!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...At any rate, Mejiro McQueen manages
to
declare her goals.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Golgol Fire Arrow! Hoooooah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh, good grief! There's no way I can
focus
under these conditions!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Listen, you! What sort of god are you
supposed
to be, anyway?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Me? A god? What're you talkin' about?
You
expressin' your undying love for me
or somethin'?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Okay, fiiine. I'll hang out with ya! Man,
it's tough
bein' so popular.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Mejiro McQueen decides to make her

declaration some other time, so we
decide to
leave the shrine.
